scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare && tauri build --bundles app
scripts.build:windows: npm run prepare && tauri build --bundles nsis
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare && tauri build --bundles deb,appimage
scripts.release:mac: npm run prepare && npm run prepare:release && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --bundles app
scripts.release:windows: npm run prepare && npm run prepare:release && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --bundles nsis
scripts.release:linux: npm run prepare && npm run prepare:release && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --bundles appimage
